an2.130:1.1: Saddho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ sammā āyācamāno āyāceyya
an2.130:1.3: Esā bhikkhave tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yadidaṃ Sāriputta-Moggallānā ti. 2.
an2.131:1.1: Saddhā bhikkhave bhikkhunī evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya
an2.131:1.2: tādisā homi yādisā Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā cā ti.
an2.131:1.3: Esā bhikkhave tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yadidaṃ Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā cā ti. 3.
an2.132:1.1: Saddho bhikkhave upāsako evaṃ sammā āyācamāno āyāceyya
an2.132:1.2: tādiso homi yādiso Citto gahapati ca Hatthako ca Āḷavako ti.
an2.132:1.3: Esā bhikkhave tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ yadidaṃ Citto ca gahapati Hatthako ca Āḷavako ti. 4.
an2.133:1.1: Saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya
an2.133:1.2: tādisā homi yādisā Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇṭakiyā ca Nandamātā ti.
an2.133:1.3: Esā bhikkhave tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ yadidaṃ Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇṭakiyā ca Nandamātā ti. 5.
an2.134:1.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an2.134:1.5: Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavatī ti.
an2.134:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an2.134:2.5: Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavatī ti. 6.
